Report of a landspout west of Burns.
Report of a landspout and a funnel cloud. Landspout lasted 8 minutes.
Delayed_ public report of quarter-sized hail 9 miles west and 3 miles north of Hawk Springs.
mPING report of flash flooding occurring near Highway 30 and Dell Range. Flooded roadways.
Public reported to dispatch of hazardous road conditions due to flooding and a few cars stranded.
There was flooding on Sheridan St and Mountain Rd. Quite a bit of mud and dirt was over the road_ and I was in that area earlier yesterday (before storms)_ which did not have that. I do want to note
Media report of flooded roadway in Slack Channel at Henderson and Forest in Cheyenne. Video shows flooded water with some motion. Water a quarter way up car tires.
NWS Employee reports 1.63 inches of rain in about 1 hour east of Cheyenne.
Public report of 1.9 inches of rain at Dell Range and Highway 30 east of Cheyenne.
NWS Employee reported standing water_ more than usual with rain_ with large drainage ditches and catch basins being completely full.
Public reported to dispatch of road flooding blocking traffic on Whiteney Road.
Report of water running over Highway 385.
Photos on social media of water running over Cherry Road and pea sized hail. PWS recording 3.74 inches of precipitation.
